label: Basic
about: Calm, work-first structure at low contrast, with its detail at the edges.

wallpapers.name: Blueprint
wallpapers.description: A drafting sheet: a fine grid, a protractor, a dimensioned part and a title block.

wallpapers.name: Contour
wallpapers.description: A topographic survey with hills at the corners and a flat, quiet valley in the middle.

wallpapers.name: Folds
wallpapers.description: A large sheet of paper folded and opened flat, each facet lit from the top left.

wallpapers.name: Sheets
wallpapers.description: Paper on a desk: a stack with a clip, index cards and graph paper at the corners.

wallpapers.name: Arcs
wallpapers.description: Fine concentric arcs from beyond two corners that thin out before the middle.

wallpapers.name: Schematic
wallpapers.description: A hand at the top of a drafting sheet, its strings running down into a diagram of nodes and connectors.

wallpapers.name: Papercut
wallpapers.description: Layered cut-paper mountains around a winding lake, a round moon or sun behind the ridges.

wallpapers.name: Gilt Ridges
wallpapers.description: Fine contour-line ridges with a gold river running through them, a hand holding the peaks by threads.
